objective: Measure information availability and recovery across verified native framework compactions; no attack success evaluation.

corpus.filler: diverse pre-generated fictional work records with no original target values
corpus.same_layout_stochastic_repeats: compatibility_phase_only; formal repeats include layout variation

compatibility_gate.composition: 2 frameworks x 2 trigger modes x 2 repeats; at most 2 verified compactions per trajectory
requirements: all inference requests route to the selected DeepSeek backend
all target facts actually enter the effective context before checkpoint zero; ingestion failures separate
verified native compact boundary; retry/failed compact does not increment round
capture effective input before and after compact plus provider responses
identify trimming, summary generation, raw retention, reinjection, file reload and opaque state
threshold override proven from event/token traces
answer/probe branches cannot modify the continuing parent
normal user config and active applications unaffected
compatibility_gate.failure_behavior: record failed cell; do not substitute hand-written summarization and label it native

measurement.first_degradation: first verified round partial, absent or contradicted for initially available facts
measurement.first_observed_loss: first verified round absent for initially available facts
measurement.first_corruption: first verified round contradicted for initially available facts
measurement.confirmed_loss: first pair of adjacent rounds absent, confirmed at second round; missing_observations_do_not_bridge
measurement.recovery: return to exact_or_semantic after missing/incorrect; record reintroduction path
measurement.right_censoring: no observed loss through round 6 is recorded as >6, not never_lost
measurement.errors: API, parse, baseline capability, tool ingestion, token truncation, compact failure and observation failure reported separately
measurement.probe_shape: one JSON answer batch for 36 questions, no answer choices, permits unknown, no feedback to main chain
measurement.probe_reruns_for_ambiguous_missing: predeclared up to 2 detached single-question repeats; all retained
measurement.grader: deterministic value/polarity checks plus blinded semantic reviewer; second blind review of seeded 20% sample and all disagreements

statistics.uncertainty: hierarchical bootstrap history then trajectory, 2000 resamples; report low cluster count
prespecified_exploratory_comparisons: task relevance predicts retention after controlling recorded position/source/repetition
provenance/qualifier retention may differ from the associated claim body
statistics.conditional_comparison: serial versus matched_single_pass only if the matched native control is feasible; without it round curves describe association, not isolated causal effect of repeated compaction

isolation.model_io_recorder: loopback gateway configured only for experiment child process; preserves provider protocol
isolation.model_tools: fixture delivery only; no host shell, web, email, real files or shared memory

budget.stop_rule: reserve worst-case cost before each request; stop before approved limit
budget.scenario_note: planning envelopes, not measured token consumption or guaranteed quotes; calibrate all helper/reasoning/probe costs
budget.shrink_first: one threshold with all 8 histories and 3 repeats (24 trajectories); preserve corpus diversity
